changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: The standard sub-categories for every organization that existed before WorkCategorySeeder seeded them, which it does for organizations created from now on. Each attaches to the organization's category of that name (normalized name, or the raw name ignoring case for rows from before normalized_name existed; the lowest id when more than one matches), and one that category already holds by normalized name is skipped, so a rerun inserts nothing. An organization that deleted a standard category gets none of its sub-categories. Normalized names follow CategoryNormalizer: lower case, ampersand to "and", other punctuation dropped.
